messages.author: b95c7fefb30aefc2
messages.subject: AHM R package
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying exercises in CH11 with SimmCom function but somehow its not working. I downloaded the AHM R functions following instructions on the website 

####(This is a skeleton R package that contains all the functions needed in AHM volume 1. After downloading it, you can install the package as a local ZIP file. Upon loading it, do help(library=AHMbook) for an incomplete list of functions with help files, but the other functions are all in there). ####


Is there some update I'm missing? 

This is the error I get:

> simComm(type="det/nondet", nsite=30, nrep=3, nspec=100, mean.psi=0.25, sig.lpsi=1, mu.beta.lpsi=0, sig.beta.lpsi=0,mean.lambda=2, sig.loglam=1, mu.beta.loglam=1,  sig.beta.loglam=1, mean.p=0.25, sig.lp=1, mu.beta.lp=0, sig.beta.lp=0,  show.plot = TRUE)


Error in ifelse(mean.psi == "1", 500, logit(mean.psi)) : could not find function "logit"


Thanks!


Andrea
